scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof with explicit quantifiers, spectral normalization, Pell parity and limiting calculations; independent auditing has not taken place.
scientific_limitations: This liminf is for the symmetric three-vertex wave envelope of the small-weak-edge limit. It does not establish a joint large-time/small-edge error theorem or all-threshold first-arrival bounds. Previously established spectral amplitude formulas and qualitative transfer characterizations are not asserted new.
title: Sharp Pell waiting-time constant for three-component weak-edge quantum pulsation
